name: copy_table_words_strided
description: Copies a long run of 16-bit words from a fixed source table into a destination buffer at regular spacing, pairing each destination slot with successive source entries. It only moves data between the two table regions.

name: fill_strided_slots_from_register
description: Broadcasts the incoming data-register value, and its low word, into a fixed pattern of destination slots at regular spacing. It writes only and reads no source table.

name: scatter_table_bytes_by_index
description: Takes a 16-bit index, shifts it to a row offset in a lookup table, and scatters that row's consecutive bytes across a grid of destination positions at fixed spacing. Seven unnamed routines call it.

name: select_row_by_compare
description: Compares a 16-bit field of the current object against half of a second field, chooses one of two lookup rows, and copies that row's bytes to destination slots at fixed spacing.

name: write_constant_row_strided
description: Calls a helper four times, then stores a fixed set of constant table bytes into destination slots at regular spacing. The constants come from literal table addresses, not from arguments.

name: dispatch_two_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns, with no data access of its own. It is a thin dispatcher.

name: broadcast_value_to_sixteen_slots
description: Stores one data-register value into a fixed set of sixteen long-word slots of a buffer addressed by an address register, then returns.

name: run_helpers_gated_by_field
description: Calls helper routines in a fixed order, including one fixed function call, and runs two extra helpers only when a 16-bit field of the current object is zero. It does dispatch only, with no arithmetic.

name: draw_visible_object_list
description: Walks a list of fixed-size object records, skips inactive ones, and shifts each position by camera offsets read from the owning object. Objects inside a fixed screen rectangle are drawn through a draw routine, or through a lookup path when a flag bit is set.

name: set_object_state_by_mode
description: Initialises fields of an object record, then switches on the low five bits of a mode word to choose per-case timing and state values. Decoding is partly broken, so only the initial stores and the dispatch are fully recovered.

name: init_object_with_callback_loop
description: Sets an object's default timing and size fields, stores a self-referencing callback pointer, and loops calling helpers until a status word changes. One flag is set from an input bit before the loop.

name: init_object_then_poll_loop
description: Applies the same default-field setup as its sibling initialiser, then runs a nested polling loop that clears a flag byte before each wait. It exits when a status word becomes nonzero.

name: init_object_poll_flag_byte
description: Applies the same default object fields, then loops on a status word while updating a flag byte in the parent record. It was reached only by decoding gap bytes, so it may be dead code.

name: init_object_wait_for_flag
description: Initialises the object defaults and callback pointer, then waits in a loop while a 16-bit field of the parent is nonzero, clearing a field on each pass before calling helpers.

name: countdown_then_invoke_callback
description: Decrements a countdown field; while it is nonzero it calls the stored callback and returns. At zero it reloads the countdown to a fixed value, installs itself as the callback, and runs a wait loop with a fixed velocity value.

name: countdown_reset_with_negative_offset
description: Decrements a countdown; while it is nonzero it calls the stored callback and returns. At zero it reloads a fixed timer, installs itself as the callback, and stores a large negative fixed value in the object before waiting.

name: idle_loop_set_max_timer
description: Calls one helper, then loops forever storing a maximum 16-bit value into an object field and calling helpers. It has no return path and acts as an idle wait.

name: spin_loop_store_max_value
description: Endless loop that repeatedly stores a maximum 16-bit value into an object field and calls a helper. It never returns.

name: countdown_clear_flag_then_reset
description: Decrements a countdown and, at zero, clears one flag bit in the parent record before the wait. It then loops toggling a second flag bit until the bit is set, and reinstalls itself as the callback.

name: countdown_toggle_flag_loop
description: Decrements a countdown and, at zero, runs a wait loop that sets and clears a flag bit in the parent record. It reinstalls itself as the callback and exits when the flag bit is set.

name: poll_flag_bit_then_countdown
description: Loops setting and clearing a flag bit in the parent record while calling helpers, and installs itself as a callback. It was reached only by decoding gap bytes, so it may be dead code.

name: countdown_on_flag_bit
description: Installs itself as a callback and sets a flag bit; when a second flag bit is set it runs a countdown that calls the stored callback until it reaches zero. Reached only by decoding gap bytes.

name: countdown_negative_offset_reset
description: Stores a large negative fixed value in the object, reloads a countdown, and calls the stored callback while the countdown is nonzero. Reached only by decoding gap bytes.

name: countdown_then_idle_on_flag
description: Decrements a countdown and calls the stored callback while it is nonzero; at zero it clears two object fields and loops on a parent flag word.

name: poll_flag_word_with_retry
description: Clears object fields, then calls a helper while a parent word is nonzero, then runs a retry loop that clears a flag bit and tests helper results before setting it again.

name: toggle_flag_until_countdown_done
description: Sets a flag bit in the parent and, while a second flag bit is clear, polls a helper; otherwise it sets a fixed value, installs a callback, and runs a countdown that invokes the stored callback.

name: countdown_positive_value_callback
description: Stores a fixed positive value in the object, installs a callback, and runs a countdown that calls the stored callback until it reaches zero, then clears a parent flag bit.

name: countdown_clear_flag_bit
description: Decrements a countdown and calls the stored callback while it is nonzero; at zero it clears a parent flag bit, then loops on a helper result before reloading the countdown.

name: poll_flag_bit_callback
description: Clears a parent flag bit, zeroes a counter field, and loops on a helper, toggling another flag bit and installing the callback until the helper reports completion.

name: set_control_flags_and_clear
description: Clears a parent flag bit, toggles a control bit in a record, and writes a fixed small value into a field at repeated offsets, calling helpers between the writes.

name: set_control_bits_sequence
description: Sets, toggles and clears control bits in a record, writing a fixed small value into a field between helper calls, and finally zeroes the control word.

name: write_bytes_at_position
description: Computes a byte address from the object's position fields and the screen row stride, then writes four bytes of one value and a fifth byte of a second value at that position.

name: poll_mode_flag_loop
description: Sets a field from a stored word and loops forever, setting a bit in the record and clearing it again when the parent mode differs from a fixed value, calling a helper on each pass.

name: dispatch_through_mode_table
description: Writes a fixed word into the object and jumps through a table indexed by a mode word from the object, calling the handler it selects.

name: advance_object_and_read_codes
description: Advances a position field, sets timing and size values and a flag, then loops reading successive helper results until a terminating code is seen.

name: copy_position_if_code_allowed
description: Reads several helper results and, unless a flag bit is set, copies two 32-bit position fields into the parent record when none of the excluded codes match.

name: init_object_defaults_and_call
description: Clears flags and sets default timing, size and position fields for an object, sets a control field to a fixed value, calls a helper, and clears the control word. Reached only by decoding gap bytes.

name: nudge_position_from_input_code
description: Sets a flag in a global status byte and returns unless another flag is set; otherwise it reads helper codes and moves a global 16-bit position by two units depending on which code matched.

name: step_position_on_state_match
description: Checks a global enable flag, then reads helper results several times and adjusts a global position by a step of two when a code matches and the state values agree.

name: move_object_by_direction_bits
description: Initialises an object's position and display fields, then while a fixed marker word in memory matches and the direction bits are set, moves the object by eight units per set bit and calls a helper on each pass.

name: init_object_with_timer_callback
description: Initialises an object with a fixed limit field of 9999, installs a callback pointer to itself, sets offset values and a control value, then calls a helper and clears the control word.

name: clear_control_longword
description: Zeroes the first 32-bit longword of the object record addressed by an address register and returns. The listed text reference and calls are not visible in the recovered body.

name: test_object_state_flags
description: Tests several state bits of the object and its parent record, returning early for some combinations and clearing a status bit otherwise. The listing is truncated, so only the flag tests are recovered.

name: test_object_state_bits
description: Runs the same visible flag tests as its neighbouring entry in this segment: state bits decide whether it returns early, and a status bit is cleared otherwise. The listing is truncated.

name: install_handler_and_set_state
description: Stores fixed values for a handler index and a data pointer in the object, sets an update bit, and calls helpers that set a counter to eleven and mark a parent state bit. The listing is truncated.

name: dispatch_two_unnamed_helpers
description: Facts show it is reached through an address-taken reference and makes two calls to unnamed routines. The decompiler timed out, so no further behaviour is recovered.

name: update_hold_flag_counter
description: Sets or clears a bit in an object field depending on a bit of the parent input word; when the bit is newly set it increments a 16-bit counter in the parent and wraps it to zero after four.

name: start_audio_dma_channels
description: Sets the pointer and length registers of two audio channels and enables DMA through the DMA control register, as the hardware references show. The decompiler timed out, so the exact sequence is not recovered.
